finalText:
React re-renders a child by default whenever its parent re-renders, no matter if the props are the same. Wrapping the child in `React.memo` fixes that, since it makes React check the props before re-rendering.

If you already use `memo` and it still re-renders, the usual cause is a prop that looks the same but isn't — an inline function or object literal in the parent's JSX. Each render makes a brand new one in memory, so `memo`'s check sees it as changed even though it reads the same. Wrap those with `useCallback` (functions) or `useMemo` (objects) in the parent.

If you share the two components, I can point at the exact prop causing it.
